regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing leadership structure with AI Infrastructure at rank 1 (eligible, breadth 0.875, not crowded, hurst mixed) and semiconductor/sub-themes filling ranks 2-5, but breadth_of_rotation is 'narrowing' (eligible frac 0.41) and absorption 0.31 with one_narrative=false, so leadership is concentrated but not dominant. Gate_helps is true, so the absolute-trend gate is the one usable discipline; cross-sectional rank is attention-only. Track record (n=84, hit_rate 0.679 but dir_accuracy 0.488) suggests naming the prevailing narrative has been decent but directional calls coin-flip, so leans are kept low conviction and conditional.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Memory, HBM & Storage (rank 2, hurst 'trend', not crowded) widens its score relative to AI Infrastructure (rank 1, hurst 'mixed') over the next 10 trading days; the watch retires if Memory/HBM fails to overtake AI Infrastructure in score while AI Infrastructure's breadth stays above 0.8.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the confirmed leader (rank 1) with the highest durability_bar among leaders (0.71) and strong breadth (0.875), and it is not crowded (crowding_z 0.84 < threshold). The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge and this theme passes eligibility, so a trend-following lean is defensible. However hurst_tag is 'mixed' not 'trend', so durability is only moderate; momentum rank itself has no return edge.
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure's hurst_tag is 'mixed', not 'trend', so the trend may already be stalling relative to Memory/HBM (hurst 'trend') or Cybersecurity (hurst 'trend'); the headline weight of 0.25 and val_state 'fading' suggest the narrative may be past peak attention.

falsifier.text: SMH makes a lower low versus the S&P 500 within the next 21 trading days while AI Infrastructure falls out of the top-2 rank

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks highly (rank 4) with a trend hurst tag and perfect breadth (1.0), but crowding_z is 1.97 and crowded=true. The guardrails explicitly prohibit fading the dominant theme on crowding, but here the dominant theme is AI Infrastructure, not Cybersecurity. For a non-dominant theme with extreme crowding, the crowding flag is a size-down caution only, and with dir_accuracy ~0.49 there is no directional edge; an 'avoid' lean expresses no new exposure, not a short or fade.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity has the strongest trend tag and full breadth — crowding may persist longer than expected in a reflexivity regime, and avoiding it means missing continued trend continuation.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms the S&P 500 by more than 4% over the next 21 trading days without a broadening of crowding below the threshold

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
